_doc: Keyswitches latch: write one only when the articulation changes. Never velocity-humanize Ample Bass J (velocity 126-127 is the accent layer). Ample names C3 = MIDI 60. Guitars (manual: Documents/Ample Sound/Manuals): string force 31-36 = 6th..1st string, one before every note (else Ample picks its own string); hammer/pull 29 and legato slide 28 need both notes overlapping on one string; velocity 127 = pop; FX 89-103 (strokes 93/94, golpe 101); auto legato off = 99 low velocity. Start Time 0 + play 45 ms early keeps the natural attack. Reference implementation: A:/CERBATANA/Ableton/2026-11-02 Fantasia San Juan/generator/lib/ample.mjs.

guitar-l._doc: Ample Guitar L is the classical (nylon) guitar, not a Les Paul. Playable range E1-C5 (40-84). Velocity (measured 2026-11-02): 33 dB from 8 to 120, hard layer change between 64 and 72 (+4..+8 dB, sharper attack), another near 100; round robin varies +-2..4 dB per note. Classical writing: pp 26, p 38, mp 46, mf 54-62, tremolo a-m-i around 40-50; only f/ff above 70. Fresh instance (measured): Auto Mod On, Auto Legato 1, Start Time 35 ms, Release 50 ms, Cycle Plus Off. Settings are chosen per piece/section, never inherited: see knowledge/composition/performance/guitar-ample-performance.md R7 (what each param does, evidence level, which value for which texture). Leave one empty bar before the first note. fxPresets are starting points for known contexts, not defaults.

delicate-arpeggio._doc: validated by ear on Remanso (Nov 2026): calm p-i-m-i, lead notes 25 ms

natural-attack._doc: full pluck, lead notes 45 ms (Fantasia default sections); vibrato only as drawn CC1

tremolo._doc: measured on Fantasia (automate only the tremolo section): lead 15 ms, drawn CC1 on long notes
